marta.chen: FYI compliance reported a permission change on prod project 'acme-pay' but our audit index shows no permission_change event for that user.
kevin.liu: which user / timestamp?
marta.chen: report line: user_id=u12345, changed role dev -> admin, event_time=2025-06-21T11:27:01Z. Reported by compliance csv export.
ashley_r: hmm we normally see an audit.permission_change event emitted by rbac-service. I can grep ES index in a min.
jaidev: we pushed the RBAC refactor three days ago; it changed the codepath that emits events and the signing flow (KMS) for audit payloads. Could be related.
kevin.liu: ashley, can you run this ES query on audit-events-*?
ashley_r: running now. query: ```GET /audit-events-*/_search?q=actor.id:u12345 AND event_type:permission_change&size=5```
ashley_r: result: 0 hits for that actor and event_type between 2025-06-21T11:00 and 11:40. We do see a token.rotate event at 11:26:58.
marta.chen: so token rotation is logged but not the role change. maybe two different services and only one emitted.
rbac-bot: note: last successful emitAuditEvent from rbac-service: 2025-06-21T10:23:12Z. emitAuditEvent attempts after 10:23:12 returned 503, retry queued.
kevin.liu: rbac-bot — can you show recent error traces or link to logs?
rbac-bot: logs: ```2025-06-21T11:27:00Z rbac-service ERROR emitAuditEvent failed: 403 PermissionDenied signing-key-access (kms.projects/redwood/keys/audit-key)```
jaidev: that matches my suspicion — KMS signing failing, so rbac-service probably aborted emitting signed audit payload and didn't fallback to unsigned emit. Our refactor accidentally made signing mandatory.
ashley_r: checking Cloud KMS audit logs now. CLI: ```gcloud logging read "protoPayload.methodName=\"google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.AsymmetricSign\" AND resource.labels.key_id=\"audit-key\"" --limit 20```
ashley_r: seeing a 403 for service account `rbac-service@prod` at 11:26:59 — key rotation / IAM binding change likely.
kevin.liu: who owns that key? security-managed?
marta.chen: keys are in prod KMS. ownership: infra-sre, but there was a rotation policy run last night. Possibly a binding change.
jaidev: plan: 1) re-enable a fallback path in rbac-service to emit unsigned audit events (short-term). 2) add a retry + queue drain for failed emits. 3) scan for other missing permission_change events during the window and backfill.
sre-oncall: I'll open an incident ticket INC-4829 and add oncall pages.
kevin.liu: Ashley — can you start the ES scan for all permission_change events between 2025-06-21T00:00 and 2025-06-22T00:00 and produce a list of actor ids with missing events relative to compliance csv? Put results in #security-ops.
nashley_r: on it. will post CSV link when done.
jaidev: I'll prepare a hotfix to make signing optional and push to canary, then make a patch that retries with exponential backoff.
marta.chen: we also need to notify compliance and Legal about potential incomplete audit trail for that window. I'll draft a notice.
kevin.liu: add temporary Prometheus alert: rbac_service_emit_failures > 0 for 5m -> page. Also create a cheap Kibana dashboard showing emitted vs expected permission_change counts per hour.
rbac-bot: created job: automated backfill extractor scheduled for 02:00 UTC daily, but it's currently disabled (flag: backfill.enabled=false).
jaidev: enable the backfill flag after we verify the signing fix.
sre-oncall: INC-4829 created, linked runbook, assigned to jaidev + ashley_r + kevin.liu.
marta.chen: thanks team. please add any findings to the ticket. if we hit P0 (customer impact) we'll escalate to execs. :eyes:
kevin.liu: ack.
ashley_r: will upload initial scan in ~20m.
rbac-bot: summary: root cause suspected = KMS signing denied after recent IAM/rotation; symptom = permission_change not emitted; mitigation = enable unsigned fallback + backfill; next steps in INC-4829.
